standard.summary: 推荐最后再尝试。交换 U-Net input blocks
standard.whenToUse: 不确定时先保持默认，小步数短测后再调。
standard.avoidWhen: 与预检冲突或与其它互斥选项同时开启时。

standard_en.summary: Recommended as the last thing to try. Swaps the U-Net input blocks
standard_en.whenToUse: When unsure keep the default; run a short low-step test before changing it.
standard_en.avoidWhen: When it conflicts with preflight, or when a mutually exclusive option is enabled at the same time.

advanced.principle: 推荐最后再尝试。交换 U-Net input blocks，显存收益较大，但通常速度损失最大

advanced_en.principle: Recommended to try last. Swaps U-Net input blocks — large VRAM savings, but usually the biggest speed loss.
